name: Npgsql9Postgres16
description: PostgreSQL as pengdows.crud testbed runs it (PostgreSqlTestContainer, TestbedImageMatrix latest).

types.query: SELECT DISTINCT format_type(t.oid, NULL) FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND t.typtype NOT IN ('p', 'c')
